description: Tables created by runtime DDL (server/, migrations/) but not declared in shared/schema. drizzle-kit cannot manage them and drizzle.config.ts filters them out of push. This list may only shrink: declare a table in shared/schema, then remove it here. tests/runtime-only-tables-ratchet.test.ts enforces it. Owner-approved on 2026-10-31 (PR #2613 main green-up): 17 tables that main's startup DDL creates for Production Target Bonuses (#2612 and follow-ups), the container extra expected lines and the destination normalization audit are recorded here rather than declared in shared/schema, because a declaration would let drizzle-kit push reconcile, and potentially drop, constraints and triggers that only the startup DDL installs. They stay in the declaration backlog. Under the same owner approval, pos_transfer_approval_settings (main #2650, POS transfer approval delegation) was recorded on the 2026-10-31 main merge for the same reason. Owner-approved on 2026-11-03 (PR #2613): factory_target_bonus_manual_payments (main's manual Production Bonuses payouts) is recorded here for the same reason; its startup DDL carries CHECK constraints and a reversal-state rule that a declaration would let drizzle-kit push reconcile. Main green-up (2026-11-05, PR #2898): customer_destination_price_lists (main #2901, destination-specific agreed prices; its startup DDL carries a positive-price CHECK and a non-blank destination CHECK) and support_ticket_attachment_blobs (main #2893, private ticket evidence bytes; its migration DDL carries the 1 byte to 5 MiB size CHECK) are recorded here for the same reason: a declaration would let drizzle-kit push reconcile those constraints. Both stay in the declaration backlog. Owner-approved on 2026-11-09 (PR #3089 main green-up): the six Factory loading-dispatch tables that main's startup DDL creates (factory_loading_dispatches, factory_loading_dispatch_scans, factory_loading_dispatch_events, factory_loading_dispatch_expected_articles, factory_loading_dispatch_expected_bales and factory_loading_dispatch_closure_history, from the Dispatch Management phases 1-7 merge) are recorded here for the same reason: server/startup/ensureFactoryLoadingDispatchSchema.ts installs their CHECK constraints, unique and partial indexes and foreign keys, which a declaration would let drizzle-kit push reconcile. They stay in the declaration backlog. Main green-up (2026-11-13, PR #2870 intercompany container trading merge): erp_supplier_return_batches and erp_supplier_return_lines (ERP supplier returns), factory_finalized_sale_returns (finalized sale return matching, #3197/#3198) and properties_account_wa_schedules and properties_account_wa_deliveries (Properties account WhatsApp statements) are created by main's runtime DDL and measured identically on a pristine origin/main worktree; they are recorded here for the same reason and stay in the declaration backlog.
